audit.whatIsWrong: Levels 2 through First item are credited to Zac/Skill while the packet chart, the 63.64% win rate, the whys and the already-audited mirror all say Nautilus owns that stretch.
audit.why: Zac is dashless until Elastic Slingshot (21s at rank 1) and cannot leave a landed Dredge Line; the lane only levels out in late teamfights where his AoE knock-up matters more than the 1v1.
audit.corrected: Levels 2, 3, 4-5, 6 and First item Nautilus; 2+ items Skill.

audit.why: Four spikes present: levels 2-3, level 6 Depth Charge, first tank item, and his level-6+ sling threat window.

audit.whatIsWrong: The range advantage and Elastic Slingshot's cooldown are never numbered, and Cell Division's blob healing is only implied by 'step on blobs'.
audit.why: Dredge Line reaches 1150 against Stretching Strikes' 800, so you can open outside his grab; Elastic Slingshot is 21/18/15/12/9s and is his only escape, which is why the whole window after it is yours. Cell Division heals him off shed blobs and revives him from bloblets, so Grievous Wounds and walking over the blobs both matter. Depth Charge is target-locked and undodgeable at 825 — it is not Unstoppable, per the mirror audit.
audit.corrected: State 1150 vs 800, the 21s sling window, and the blob heal/anti-heal rule.

edits.before: Step on blobs — Q-hook into CC, anti-heal him. Nautilus wins the Elastic Slingshot cooldown windows.
edits.after: Step on his blobs and anti-heal — hook from 1150, outside his 800 grab, then chain your CC.

edits.before: Deny blobs and chain CC. Track Elastic Slingshot before every commit and keep the wave on your side.
edits.after: Deny blobs, anti-heal, and chain CC through the 21s after his sling — he has no other way out.

edits.before: His engage. Q-peel after it. Only engage once it is down or baited.
edits.after: His only escape, 21s at rank 1 — own the whole window after he spends it.

edits.before: That is Zac's favourite window — refuse it and half his win condition is gone.
edits.after: Cell Division blobs heal him — walk over them and bring Grievous Wounds.

edits.before: Burning it for tiny value leaves you naked for its full cooldown.
edits.after: His sling grounds and knocks up on landing — sidestep where it lands.

notes: Mirror (zac vs nautilus) was already audited and agrees Nautilus owns the lane phases; ratings set inverse to that side. Used its confirmed facts rather than re-deriving them: Depth Charge is target-locked and undodgeable at 825 (not Unstoppable), Dredge Line 1150 vs Stretching Strikes 800, Riptide every 7s at rank 1.
